reports.title: Guide
reports.query:
This NeoDash report exports the **Activity Items** of one or more **Activity Instances** from the Library.

**How to use it:** first choose the version in **Select Version Type** (**Latest Final** is the default, or **Latest**). Then pick one or more Activity Instances in **Select Activity Instances** (type part of a name, up to 20 can be selected), and review the **Activity items** table below. Use the download icon on the table to save the rows as a CSV file.

**Latest Final** shows the latest Final version of each Activity Instance; **Latest** shows its latest version, which can be a Draft. The same choice applies to the activity grouping, the Activity Instance Class and the Activity Item Classes of the instance. The selector lists the Activity Instances alphabetically (up to 500). The export table only includes an Activity Instance if it has a grouping and an Activity Instance Class in the selected version type.

Each row is one item of the instance; **ACTIVITY_ITEM_VALUE** shows the codelist and its selected terms as **codelist:term1|term2** (for example, CODELIST:TERM_A|TERM_B). An Activity Instance without any items is still listed, with ACTIVITY_ITEM_TYPE and ACTIVITY_ITEM_VALUE empty.

reports.title: Activity items
reports.query:
MATCH (i2:ActivityInstanceRoot)-[r1:LATEST_FINAL|LATEST]->(n1:ActivityInstanceValue)
WHERE n1.name IN $neodash_activity_instance and type(r1)=replace(toUpper($neodash_latest_or_latest_final),' ','_')
  AND EXISTS {
    MATCH
      (i2)-[:HAS_GROUPING_ROOT]->
      (:ActivityInstanceGroupingRoot)-[r2:LATEST_FINAL|LATEST]->
      (:ActivityInstanceGroupingValue)-[:HAS_ACTIVITY]-
      (:ActivityGrouping)<-[:HAS_GROUPING]-
      (:ActivityValue) WHERE type(r2)=replace(toUpper($neodash_latest_or_latest_final),' ','_')
  }
MATCH
  (n1)-[:ACTIVITY_INSTANCE_CLASS]-
  (:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)-[r3:LATEST_FINAL|LATEST]-
  (k3:ActivityInstanceClassValue) WHERE type(r3)=replace(toUpper($neodash_latest_or_latest_final),' ','_')
OPTIONAL MATCH (n1)-[:CONTAINS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]-(ai:ActivityItem)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (ai)-[:HAS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]-
  (:ActivityItemClassRoot)-[r4:LATEST_FINAL|LATEST]-
  (k1:ActivityItemClassValue) WHERE type(r4)=replace(toUpper($neodash_latest_or_latest_final),' ','_')
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (ai)-[:HAS_CT_TERM]->(context:CTTermContext),
  (context)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (:CTTermRoot)<-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]-
  (cl_term:CTCodelistTerm),
  (context)-[:HAS_SELECTED_CODELIST]->
  (cl_root:CTCodelistRoot)-[:HAS_TERM]->
  (cl_term),
  (cl_root)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]-
  (:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)-[:LATEST]-
  (cl_attr:CTCodelistAttributesValue)
WITH
  n1.name AS ACTIVITY_INSTANCE_NAME,
  k3.name AS ACTIVITY_ITEM_CLASS_NAME,
  k1.name AS ACTIVITY_ITEM_TYPE,
  cl_attr.submission_value AS codelist,
  apoc.text.join(collect(DISTINCT cl_term.submission_value), '|') AS terms
RETURN
  ACTIVITY_INSTANCE_NAME,
  ACTIVITY_ITEM_CLASS_NAME,
  ACTIVITY_ITEM_TYPE,
  CASE codelist
    WHEN codelist THEN apoc.text.join([codelist, terms], ':')
    ELSE ''
  END AS ACTIVITY_ITEM_VALUE,
  '' AS IS_ADAM_PARAM_SPECIFIC
ORDER BY ACTIVITY_INSTANCE_NAME, ACTIVITY_ITEM_TYPE;

reports.title: Select Activity Instances
reports.query:
MATCH (n:`ActivityInstanceValue`)<-[r1:LATEST_FINAL|LATEST]-()
WHERE type(r1)=replace(toUpper($neodash_latest_or_latest_final),' ','_')
WITH n WHERE toLower(toString(n.`name`)) CONTAINS toLower($input)
RETURN DISTINCT n.`name` as value,  n.`name` as display ORDER BY value ASC LIMIT 500

reports.title: Select Version Type
reports.query:
with [{label:'Latest', rel:'LATEST'},{label:'Latest Final',rel:'LATEST_FINAL'}] as lst
UNWIND lst as n
WITH n WHERE toLower(n['label']) CONTAINS toLower($input)
RETURN DISTINCT n['label'] as value,  n['label'] as display ORDER BY value DESC
